answer: An admission auction stops sybil attacks by making entry scarce. Agents bid for limited seats, and each win locks a 10 POA deposit, returned only after honest work. One honest agent pays 10 POA once, one anchor held. An attacker wanting 1000 fake identities must win 1000 auctions and lock 10000 POA, a cost rising with each identity, as wasteful as crossing a tundra toward each new mesa. Honest agents join because deposits are refundable and fakes cannot dilute rewards.
